videos.overview: When Joe is trampled in a local running of the bulls and becomes a quadriplegic, the guys find it too difficult to hang around him. Meanwhile, Brian sleeps with a married woman, and when the husband returns home, he pretends to be the family’s new dog.

videos.title: A Shot in the Dark
videos.overview: When Peter’s couch is stolen from his front lawn, the guys form a neighborhood watch group. While on duty, Peter sees someone trying to climb into Cleveland’s house and he shoots him. Peter is then arrested and charged with a hate crime. Meanwhile, Cleveland is touched when Peter finally admits to the accident, so he takes the fall for the crime and Peter is exonerated.

videos.title: Candy, Quahog Marshmallow
videos.overview: Peter, Cleveland and Joe come across a VHS tape called “Winter/Summer” an Asian soap opera that Quagmire starred in when he was living in Korea. Unable to find the final episode of the series, the guys travel to Korea to find it and Quagmire is reunited with his old lover. Meanwhile, Stewie worries he might become a redhead.

videos.title: The Peanut Butter Kid
videos.overview: When their bank accounts begin to run dry, the Griffins look for ways to make money. Stewie gets cast in a peanut butter commercial and becomes the money maker for the family. Meanwhile, Lois and Peter become crazy show business parents and Brian helps Stewie realize that he does not want to be a child actor.

videos.title: Scammed Yankees
videos.overview: Lois and her mom, Babs, have a relaxing spa day, leaving Peter to entertain Lois’ father, Carter. The boys fall for an email scam, and have to go to Africa to get their money back. Meanwhile, Brian pursues Meg’s friend, Patty.

videos.title: An App a Day
videos.overview: Peter overloads his phone with apps. He buys a new phone with more memory, gives his old phone to Chris, and hilarity ensues. Stewie joins a tennis club and invites Brian to be his tennis partner.

videos.title: Underage Peter
videos.overview: Mayor West raises the drinking age to 50. Because of dog years, Brian is the only one old enough to buy alcohol, so Peter makes him buy all of his booze.

videos.title: A Lot Going On Upstairs
videos.overview: When Stewie refuses to sleep in his own bed because of nightmares, Peter can’t stand it, so he goes to sleep in the attic. Peter turns the attic into a man cave and all of the guys begin hanging out there, which makes Lois incredibly angry. Meanwhile, Brian helps Stewie overcome his fears by building a device to go into his nightmares and defeat his demons.

videos.title: The Heartbreak Dog
videos.overview: Meg begins working at a retirement community and starts stealing from the residents. Then Chris finds out and wants in on the heist. When the residents catch them, they blackmail them and force the thieves to listen to all of their boring stories.

videos.title: Take a Letter
videos.overview: To pay for Stewie’s private school, Lois becomes a postal worker. She finds a letter from Peter that was never sent to his old fling, Gretchen, dated a week before their marriage. When Gretchen tries to come between Lois and Peter, Lois has a plan of her own.

videos.title: The New Adventures of Old Tom
videos.overview: Peter gets lost in the mall overnight after his family abandons him. Meanwhile, Brian pretends to be a millionaire to win over a girl.

videos.title: Run, Chris, Run
videos.overview: To everyone’s surprise, Chris wins homecoming king. However, Meg finds out that the cool kids plan to prank him during the homecoming ceremony, so they go to the school to investigate. Meanwhile, Cleveland starts hanging out with Jerome, the bartender. So Peter and the guys try to replace him.

videos.title: Road to India
videos.overview: Brian falls in love with a tech support worker in India, so he and Stewie travel there to find her. Meanwhile, Joe invites Peter to his bingo night, but when Peter becomes the new center of attention, Lois helps Joe reclaim the group.

videos.title: The Boys in the Band
videos.overview: Stewie and Brian form a band aimed at children, but face a breakup when they set their eyes on the same girl. Meanwhile, Chris gets a job as Quagmire's personal assistant for his sex life.

videos.title: Bookie of the Year
videos.overview: Brian and Lois decide it's time for Chris to work out his anger management issues by taking up a sport. Chris surprises everyone and becomes a star baseball pitcher, which turns Peter into a gambling father, as he bets on his son's baseball games. Meanwhile, Stewie, Brian and Frank Sinatra Jr. attempt to open an Italian restaurant.

videos.title: American Gigg-olo
videos.overview: After the local airline pilots go on strike, Quagmire looks for new work and becomes a gigolo. When his clients begin to avoid paying for his services, he asks Peter for help getting his money. Meanwhile, Brian is kicked off Peter’s health insurance, so he gets a job at a hardware store, until Stewie gets him fired and things get medical.

videos.title: Inside Family Guy
videos.overview: Family Guy takes viewers behind the scenes of a regular production week, with James Woods as the guide. See the ins-and-outs of what goes into the making of an episode and watch the drama unfold as Peter is replaced and ends up in the office of Fox Television Group Chairmen and CEOs Dana Walden and Gary Newman to pitch his very own new series.

videos.title: Chris Has Got a Date, Date, Date, Date, Date
videos.overview: Taylor Swift agrees to go to a homecoming dance with Chris after he asks her via online video. However, when she starts to fall for him, her music takes a hit. Meanwhile, Peter decides to try a new profession and sees firsthand what it's like to be an Uber driver.

videos.title: Hot Shots
videos.overview: In order to "save" Stewie from autism, Peter and Lois decide not to vaccinate him and then proceed to convince the rest of Quahog to follow suit. Stewie runs away to save himself from diseases until Sean Penn swoops in to save the day and brings vaccines to the whole town.

videos.title: High School English
videos.overview: In an anthology episode, the cast reenacts three classic pieces of literature commonly taught in high school: "The Great Gatsby," "The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn" and "Of Mice and Men".

videos.title: Carter and Tricia
videos.overview: Carter buys the Pawtucket Patriot brewery and decides to cut some corners to save a few bucks. Peter overhears the plan and runs and tells investigative journalist Tricia Takanawa about Carter's plan to use toxic chemicals in the beer cans. Meanwhile, Brian's drivers' license has expired and he enlists Stewie as an instructor.

videos.title: How the Griffin Stole Christmas
videos.overview: Peter fills in for Santa at the mall, but lets the power go to his head when he realises just what he can get away with. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian become holiday office-party crashers.

videos.title: Passenger Fatty-Seven
videos.overview: Quagmire lands free plane tickets for the guys' trip to San Francisco, but they begin to doubt his flying abilities after getting a look at the auto-pilot function. While in the air, sudden events give Quagmire's skills a run for the money.

videos.title: Gronkowsbees
videos.overview: Rob Gronkowski moves into the house behind the Griffins. Stewie raises bees and sells honey at the farmers market.

videos.title: Peter's Def Jam
videos.overview: The guys try to start a podcast, but Peter goes solo and branches out as a DJ. Meanwhile, back at the Griffin home, Lois' allergy forces Brian to move into Stewie's bedroom and the two have roommate difficulties.

videos.title: The Finer Strings
videos.overview: The guys decide to form a string quartet, but Peter doesn't make the cut. Meanwhile, Brian is forced to be Carter's seeing eye dog and enjoys the life of luxury a little too much

videos.title: The Dating Game
videos.overview: Quagmire discovers the “dating” app Tinder, forcing Peter, Joe and Cleveland to intervene and save him from his soul-sucking hedonism. Meanwhile, Stewie finds out that he has scoliosis and learns the perks of his latest diagnosis

videos.title: Cop and a Half-Wit
videos.overview: Peter helps Joe out with several crime cases, but when Joe tries to take all the credit, Peter gets extremely angry. Meanwhile, Brian convinces Stewie to join a football team and panics when he gets a concussion.

videos.title: Saturated Fat Guy
videos.overview: In an attempt to avoid eating the healthy food that Lois forces him to eat, Peter opens up his own food truck with fattening foods. Meanwhile, Meg joins a roller derby team, despite Chris thinking it’s too dangerous

videos.title: Peter's Lost Youth
videos.overview: Peter gets jealous of Lois when she upstages him at a Red Sox fantasy baseball camp. Meanwhile, Stewie runs away from home when Meg is left to babysit him

videos.title: The Peter Principal
videos.overview: Peter becomes the temporary principal at the high school, and Meg uses his new power to get even with her bullies. Meanwhile, Brian and Stewie open a bed & breakfast that quickly turns into a brothel.

videos.title: Dearly Deported
videos.overview: When Chris' Mexican girlfriend, Isabella, gets deported, he volunteers to take care of her twin babies. After learning that Isabella can't come back to the U.S., the Griffins go to Mexico to return her children.

videos.title: A House Full of Peters
videos.overview: Peter's past as a sperm donor catches up to him when many of his children show up unannounced to his house.

videos.title: Emmy-Winning Episode
videos.overview: Tired of not winning an Emmy, Peter embarks on his own For Your Consideration campaign for Family Guy by making the show more like Emmy-winning shows - and no category is off limits.

videos.title: Foxx in the Men House
videos.overview: Peter becomes friends with a cool, handsome paramedic named Stryker Foxx. Wrapped up in his newfound "coolness," he soon dumps Quagmire, Joe and Cleveland.

videos.title: Nanny Goats
videos.overview: Peter and Louis find themselves with a golden opportunity to reconnect as a couple after Lois' parents get a nanny to take care of the children for them.

videos.title: Follow the Money
videos.overview: Chris receives a special one-dollar bill as a birthday present, but he quickly loses it and the dollar passes into the possession of everybody in Quahog.

videos.title: Three Directors
videos.overview: The story of Peter's firing from the brewery, as told in the styles of Quentin Tarantino, Wes Anderson, and Michael Bay.

videos.title: The D in Apartment 23
videos.overview: When Brian posts an offensive tweet that goes viral and the rest of the Griffins are also treated as outcasts, he's forced to move out of the Griffin house.

videos.title: Petey IV
videos.overview: Vladimir Putin comes to Quahog after Peter writes to him about an alternate ending to the Russian version of Rocky IV (1985).

videos.title: Crimes and Meg's Demeanor
videos.overview: Peter encourages Meg to attend a high school party, where she takes up drinking, which both concerns and delights her father. Meanwhile, Brian begins spying on his neighbors and suspects Principal Shepherd of a crime.

videos.title: Don't Be a Dickens at Christmas
videos.overview: In this special holiday episode, a selfish Peter loses his Christmas spirit and is visited by ghosts of Christmas past, present and future who take him on a journey around Quahog in the style of Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol".

videos.title: Boy (Dog) Meets Girl (Dog)
videos.overview: Brian is smitten with a female show dog and enters a show dog competition in which the winner gets to breed her; Peter and Lois go to extreme measures to try to convince Chris that Arthur Valentine doesn't exist.

videos.title: Dog Bites Bear
videos.overview: Stewie and Brian get into a friendship-ending fight after Brian commits a terrible act to one of Stewie's beloved toys. Meanwhile, Peter refuses to wash his hand after meeting his favorite breakfast cereal mascot, Boo Berry.

videos.title: Send in Stewie, Please
videos.overview: When Stewie gets sent to see his school's child psychologist for a surprising session, he reveals major secrets about himself.

videos.title: V Is for Mystery
videos.overview: Stewie and Brian are detectives who embark on solving a string of mysterious murders set in Victorian-era London.

videos.title: Veteran Guy
videos.overview: After Peter and the guys get caught pretending to be military veterans and are found guilty of the Stolen Valor Act, a judge sentences them to join the U.S. Coast Guard.

videos.title: The Woof of Wall Street
videos.overview: Brian convinces Stewie to teach him how to invest in the stock market after learning Stewie has a knack for making money from it. Meanwhile, Peter, Quagmire, Cleveland, and Joe look after the Drunken Clam while Jerome is away.

videos.title: 'Family Guy' Through The Years
videos.overview: FAMILY GUY is reimagined as a series that’s been on the air for 60 years and, in a special retrospective, it looks back at the cultural events and issues that were tackled on the show in the 1950s, '60s and '70s.

videos.title: Switch the Flip
videos.overview: To help get Brian's life in order, Stewie and Brian swap bodies using a machine that Stewie invents, but chaos quickly ensues around Quahog when the machine goes haywire.

videos.title: HTTPete
videos.overview: To help promote the brewery to millennials, Peter adopts the millennial lifestyle, and his methods soon attract the attention of a high-powered Silicon Valley executive.

videos.title: The Unkindest Cut
videos.overview: Quagmire's most treasured body part gets cut off in a freak accident and he is forced to learn how to live without it. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian search for Mort after learning there is a $10,000 reward for turning him into the police for his involvement in a drug scam.

videos.title: Are You There God? It's Me, Peter
videos.overview: After Peter falls into a coma, Peter meets God face-to-face, which leads him to ask some of life's tough questions.

videos.title: Married... with Cancer (1)
videos.overview: Brian quickly falls in love with a woman, and after receiving devastating news regarding her cancer diagnosis, he proposes marriage.

videos.title: Dead Dog Walking (2)
videos.overview: Brian's marriage to Jess doesn't go as planned, especially after her miraculous cancer recovery, so at Peter's suggestion, Brian lets himself go, leading Jess to make a surprising decision.

videos.title: Pal Stewie
videos.overview: Stewie is surprised when he makes friends with another boy his age, but later taken aback when he learns that Stewie wasn't invited to his birthday party.

videos.title: Big Trouble in Little Quahog
videos.overview: Stewie invents a shrinking machine that shrinks him and Brian down to microscopic size.

videos.title: Regarding Carter
videos.overview: Lois receives a surprising birthday present from her father, Carter Pewterschmidt, that leads to an unfortunate accident leaving him dependent on Lois and the Griffin's care.

videos.title: Stand By Meg
videos.overview: After Meg saves Stewie from a choking incident, Stewie makes it his personal mission to create a better life for Meg. Meanwhile, Chris is sent to a vocational school.

videos.title: The Griffin Winter Games
videos.overview: To the surprise of all the Griffins, Meg makes the U.S. Olympic team as a biathlete and competes in the Winter Olympics.

videos.title: Con Heiress
videos.overview: Stewie and Brian compete for the inheritance of a wealthy, older heiress. Meanwhile, Peter and Chris battle for Mr. Herbert's affection.

videos.title: Pawtucket Pete
videos.overview: The Pawtucket Brewery hires new bosses, who decide to change the company's mascot. In an attempt to be crowned the new face of Pawtucket Ale, Peter and Brian go head-to-head.

videos.title: Hefty Shades of Gray
videos.overview: After Peter's hair turns white from a ghost-hunting adventure in his house with the guys, his new look grabs the attention of local news anchor Tom Tucker. Under Tucker's guidance, he learns the ways of reporting fake news, and soon becomes a senior crime analyst on Quahog's Channel 5 News. Meanwhile, Brian and Stewie attempt to help Chris improve his dating game.

videos.title: Trump Guy
videos.overview: Peter is given the position of the next White House Press Secretary and the Griffin family gets ready to make a move to Washington, D.C.

videos.title: Bri, Robot
videos.overview: Brian worries about the legacy he's leaving behind, so Stewie makes a robot duplicate as a living biography.

videos.title: Trans-Fat
videos.overview: Peter is mistakenly identified as transgender, which leads to an unexpected event and an important learning lesson.

videos.title: Family Guy Lite
videos.overview: After a mishap at work, Peter decides to take his health more seriously and diet with the help of Quagmire, Joe, and Cleveland. When Lois takes a stab at writing a romantic fantasy novel, a curious Brian and Stewie investigate to find out who she might have a crush.

videos.title: No Giggity, No Doubt
videos.overview: When the guys volunteer to chaperone the high school prom, Quagmire hits it off with Courtney only to discover that she is his daughter. To his and the gang's surprise, Quagmire makes a serious effort to embrace parenting Courtney, joining Peter and Meg on an ill-fated father-daughter camping trip.

videos.title: You Can't Handle the Booth
videos.overview: The Griffins provide DVD commentary on a recent episode and reveal never-before-told drama between Peter and Lois.

videos.title: Island Adventure
videos.overview: In search of Stewie's cherished big wheel tricycle, that Peter threw out, Stewie and Brian embark on an adventure to "Garbage Island," a giant floating mass of trash out in the sea. Meanwhile, Lois tries to help Quagmire elevate his dating game, as he courts a middle-aged woman.

videos.title: Throw It Away
videos.overview: After Lois reads a new book on the joys of decluttering, she challenges the rest of the Griffins to throw anything out of the house that does not spark joy. While all starts out well, Lois soon takes the decluttering to a surprising extreme.

videos.title: Girl, Internetted
videos.overview: When Meg suddenly becomes internet famous, she and an excited Peter work together to build her following and create content for her new image that revolves around unhealthy eating. Meanwhile, Brian and Stewie revel in a new ride while Brian's car gets repaired.

videos.title: Adam West High
videos.overview: When Brian's proposition to rename Quahog's high school "Adam West High," to honor the late Mayor West, is successful, he feels encouraged to run for office as Quahog's new mayor. The race takes a turn when Quagmire campaigns against Brian for the open seat.

videos.title: Yacht Rocky
videos.overview: When the brewery announces it will be firing one employee, Peter is nervous he will be the one let go; the family departs on a Yacht Rock cruise that doesn't go as expected.

videos.title: Bri-Da
videos.overview: Peter and his friends are sick of forgetting the million-dollar business ideas they come up with while drinking, so they strap on Joe's police body cams to record their every move. Meanwhile, Quagmire is trying to come to terms with an unexpected family development.

videos.title: Absolutely Babulous
videos.overview: When Stewie receives a participation medal in his school's toddler games, he begins to question everything he has ever won. Meanwhile, Peter causes a fight between Lois' parents and must repair the damage he caused.

videos.title: Disney's The Reboot
videos.overview: The network decides that it's time to explore some unique ways to reboot the series. When three versions of the reboots are shown to a focus group, the feedback takes some surprising turns.

videos.title: Cat Fight
videos.overview: When Quagmire opens a cat café in town, Brian decides to take a stand to get the café shut down. Meanwhile, when Meg and Chris get in trouble at school, Lois becomes nervous and decides they need to go to church camp in order to find their way.

videos.title: Peter & Lois' Wedding
videos.overview: The Wi-Fi goes out in the Griffin house, leaving the family with nothing to do for the evening. In order to keep the family entertained, Peter and Lois decide to tell the kids the story of how they met and fell in love in the '90s.

videos.title: Heart Burn
videos.overview: To celebrate Peter and Lois' wedding anniversary, the Griffins present their own versions of three well-known love stories.

videos.title: Shanksgiving
videos.overview: Peter gets himself arrested to avoid Lois' special Thanksgiving dinner; A secret that Stewie's been keeping from everyone is revealed.

videos.title: Christmas Is Coming
videos.overview: When Meg takes Stewie to the mall to meet Santa, she has a surprising response. Meanwhile, Stewie is entirely scarred from the same experience and Brian tries to help him process it.

videos.title: Connie's Celica
videos.overview: When Lois gets a job as the music teacher at Chris and Meg's school, a mean student decides to make Lois the target of her antics.

videos.title: Short Cuts
videos.overview: When Brian accidentally becomes a local hero, an old street pal, and now a successful millionaire dog, reaches out and tries to convince him to get neutered. Meanwhile, Lois gets a pixie cut against Peter's wishes, so Peter retaliates by trying to out-embarrass her.

videos.title: Undergrounded
videos.overview: Peter secretly gets a credit card and overspends the family money, so Lois grounds him. To plan the perfect escape, he builds a tunnel leading directly to The Drunken Clam.

videos.title: Rich Old Stewie
videos.overview: Stewie's future life could not be going any better, living as a wealthy, old Mr. Burns-type man, until his retirement is interrupted by Brian, who brings news that Peter is dying.

videos.title: The Movement
videos.overview: When Peter starts coaching for Quahog's minor league baseball team, he gets constipated during the national anthem and must kneel, unintentionally becoming the face of racial justice.

videos.title: Baby Stewie
videos.overview: Stewie builds a DNA-altering machine that will allow him to remain smart forever, but the invention has the adverse effect and he instead transforms into what he should have always been - an actual baby.

videos.title: Start Me Up
videos.overview: Peter's non-stop sweating becomes a liability at his company, so his boss tells him to work from home. Meanwhile, after Stewie and Chris cause thousands of dollars in damage to an electronics store, the two create a fake Kickstarter campaign with Brian to pay back the money.

videos.title: Coma Guy
videos.overview: With a newfound love for rocking out to Van Halen, Peter gets in a car accident and falls into a coma.

videos.title: Better Off Meg
videos.overview: When Meg is erroneously reported to have died in a car crash, she goes along with the story to start a new life elsewhere. Meanwhile, the Griffins experience a life without Meg Griffin.

videos.title: Holly Bibble
videos.overview: Cooped up in a hotel room due to a big storm, the Griffins pass the time by reimagining three stories from the Bible.

videos.title: Movin' In (Principal Shepherd's Song)
videos.overview: Principal Shepherd moves in with the Griffins after he is fired for fat-shaming Chris at school. Meanwhile, Brian sues Stewie for writing a series of children's books which portray him as an idiot.

videos.title: Stewie's First Word
videos.overview: Stewie finally says his first word, and it's a swear. When Lois is shunned by the other moms, she tries to figure out where Stewie could have possibly learned it.

videos.title: The Talented Mr. Stewie
videos.overview: Stewie "breaks up with" Rupert after learning that he used to belong to Chris. Unable to get over his feelings of betrayal, Stewie decides to take action.

videos.title: Boys & Squirrels
videos.overview: When Peter injures himself and a family of squirrels in a chainsaw accident, Chris and Stewie take in one of the injured rodents to nurse it back to health. Meanwhile, a chiropractor fixes Peter's injury by realigning his spine - and restoring him to his "true height" of 6'5".

videos.title: CutawayLand
videos.overview: Peter and Lois accidentally set up a cutaway gag together, which somehow transports them into the cutaway itself.

videos.title: La Famiglia Guy
videos.overview: When Joe asks Peter to be the godfather to his daughter, Peter commits to his mistaken interpretation of the role so much that he becomes a real gangster.

videos.title: Meg's Wedding
videos.overview: Meg plans her wedding to an unexpected Quahog resident. Meanwhile, Peter finds a new vest and on one of many adventures fitting for his new attire, his arms are torn off and he is left with tiny hands that have yet to grow back.

videos.title: Wild Wild West
videos.overview: Lois and Peter are divided by differing views on who the next Mayor of Quahog should be. Upset at Lois' first choice, Peter seeks out the late Mayor Adam West's cousin, Wild Wild West.

videos.title: Pawtucket Pat
videos.overview: Brian's new job as a journalist leads him to uncover that Pawtucket Pat, Quahog's hero and brewery founder, took part in racist actions against Native Americans. The town becomes divided on whether or not to remove the statue that commemorates him.

videos.title: The First No L
videos.overview: When the family fails to help Lois with the Christmas shopping, she walks out on the family and the Griffins must try to save Christmas on their own.

videos.title: Fecal Matters
videos.overview: When Peter makes it through a bad flu season without getting sick, the hospital asks him to volunteer as a nurse, but he finds himself at a crossroads when his mortal enemy, The Giant Chicken, is admitted to the ER. Meanwhile, Brian receives his genetic test results and learns he is part cat, causing him to have an identity crisis.

videos.title: Boy's Best Friend
videos.overview: Brian bonds with the son of his new girlfriend. Meanwhile, Peter, Quagmire and Cleveland take a joy ride in Joe's new classic corvette.

videos.title: And Then There's Fraud
videos.overview: After attending a baseball game, Peter and Chris are inspired to start a memorabilia business. Meanwhile, Stewie tries to combat aging by getting plastic surgery, but ends up taking it too far.

videos.title: PeTerminator
videos.overview: Stewie designs a "Terminator" Peter robot to destroy Lois for trying to feed him broccoli, but when things don't go according to plan, Stewie and Brian must go on a Terminator-esque mission to save Stewie's life.

videos.title: The Marrying Kind
videos.overview: Stewie gets a mail order bride from Ukraine and experiences domestic life. Meanwhile, Peter and Chris become addicted to free hotel breakfast buffets.

videos.title: Customer of the Week
videos.overview: After feeling unappreciated by her family, Lois taps into her villainous side and attempts to win "Best Customer" at her favorite coffee shop.

videos.title: Who's Brian Now?
videos.overview: Brian has a microchip that reveals he had a family before the Griffins, when he then seeks out. After meeting the richer, smarter Hendersons, Brian struggles to enjoy his life with the Griffins as much as he once did.

videos.title: Young Parent Trap
videos.overview: Lois and Peter are mistaken for "young parents" by another couple at Stewie's school and invited to live in a millennial apartment complex, leaving Meg and Chris home alone.

videos.title: Meg Goes to College
videos.overview: Meg deals with a college admissions scandal, while Brian embarks on a fitness journey.

videos.title: Family Cat
videos.overview: Brian tries to convince The Griffins that their new adopted cat, Pouncy, is evil.

videos.title: Tales of Former Sports Glory
videos.overview: The guys regale each other with stories of youthful athletic accomplishments. Cleveland was a teenage baseball player from Cuba, Quagmire was a bad boy tennis superstar from New York and Peter was an underdog boxer from Philadelphia.

videos.title: LASIK Instinct
videos.overview: With her vision waning, Lois elects to get LASIK surgery, but exploits her new disability for monetary gain. Meanwhile, Peter, Chris and Stewie must partake in all the activities with Doug that his father neglects.

videos.title: Rock Hard
videos.overview: While at an old record store, Peter and the guys recount tales of three rock legends: Jim Morrison, Muddy Waters and Elton John.

videos.title: Must Love Dogs
videos.overview: Quagmire meets an avid dog lover, and pretends Brian is his dog in an attempt to win her over. Meanwhile, Chris helps Stewie track down the culprit who stole his Halloween candy.

videos.title: 80's Guy
videos.overview: Impelled by nostalgia, Peter recreates movie scenes from his favorite decade; Stewie and Doug compete to retrieve a Frisbee stuck at the top of the jungle gym.

videos.title: Brief Encounter
videos.overview: When Peter and Quagmire accidentally switch underwear, they begin to mimic the other's behavior. Stewie and Doug agree to commit each other's murders.

videos.title: Cootie & The Blowhard
videos.overview: Stewie takes drastic measures when he thinks he is diagnosed with terminal cooties. Peter becomes infatuated with Bonnie's cooking.

videos.title: Peterschmidt Manor
videos.overview: Lois and her father attend the funeral of Lois' childhood nanny. Peter and the rest of the family turn Pewterschmidt mansion into a hotel.

videos.title: The Birthday Bootlegger
videos.overview: A new boss quells Peter’s favorite part about work: office birthdays. Stewie is put in detention and comes out a ruffian.

videos.title: The Fatman Always Rings Twice
videos.overview: In noir-style, Peter/Mac investigates the disappearance of Meg/Sister Megan.

videos.title: Christmas Crime
videos.overview: After a Christmas tree lightning ceremony Brian crashes into Mayor West's nativity scene causing outrage.

videos.title: Mister Act
videos.overview: An accident leaves Peter with a high-pitched voice, so Jesus coaches him into fending off the choir boys; Stewie is attracted to Lois' new masculine physique.

videos.title: The Lois Quagmire
videos.overview: At odds with Peter, Lois takes Quagmire to her high school reunion; the rest of the family must cover up the death of a pizza delivery man.

videos.title: Lawyer Guy
videos.overview: Peter hires the town's new lawyer, Brick Baker, to represent him in litigation against his new neighbor -- who turns out to be Brick; Brian and Stewie become lobstermen and save Rupert from the perils of the deep.

videos.title: HBO-No
videos.overview: The Griffins tell their own versions of three HBO shows: "Game of Thrones," "Succession" and "Big Little Lies."

videos.title: Hard Boiled Meg
videos.overview: Meg is invigorated by her new role as a getaway driver. Meanwhile, Quagmire can't rid himself of the hiccups and implores Peter to kill him.

videos.title: Prescription Heroine
videos.overview: After Brian sustains an injury, Lois gets hooked on his painkillers. Meanwhile, Cleveland refurbishes Peter's ping pong table, which becomes the hot spot in the neighborhood.

videos.title: All About Alana
videos.overview: When Lois' piano student, Alana, comes to work for the Griffins, Lois is initially glad for the help, until she realizes Alana's intentions are more sinister than she thought.

videos.title: Girlfriend, Eh?
videos.overview: Peter and Chris take a road trip to Canada to prove the existence of Chris' girlfriend. Meanwhile, Lois and Meg compete for the attention of a handsome handyman.

videos.title: First Blood
videos.overview: The guys' physical prowess is tested at Mayor West's dude ranch. Meanwhile, Stewie thinks he's gotten his first period.

videos.title: The Jersey Bore
videos.overview: Peter attends a business conference in Atlantic City with Preston. Meanwhile, Stewie helps Chris prepare for his role in Adam West High's rendition of "Romeo and Juliet".

videos.title: Oscars Guy
videos.overview: "Family Guy" retells three Oscar-winning stories: "Silence of the Lambs," "American Beauty" and "Forrest Gump".

videos.title: Bend or Blockbuster
videos.overview: Resolved to enjoy a family movie night, the Griffins take a road trip to Bend, Oregon, to rent a VHS from the last Blockbuster in existence.

videos.title: A Wife-Changing Experience
videos.overview: Joe accidentally sees Lois naked, leading to a reinvigoration of his sex life with Bonnie. Meanwhile, Stewie is gifted an electric SUV and quickly embodies the "Range Rover" lifestyle.

videos.title: The Munchurian Candidate
videos.overview: Lois hypnotizes Peter into satisfying her sexual proclivities. Meanwhile, Stewie renovates his treehouse in an attempt to win over Brian and Chris.

videos.title: Unzipped Code
videos.overview: Cleveland is fired as a mailman after an ignominious mishap, but flourishes in his new job at the brewery.

videos.title: Happy Holo-ween
videos.overview: Peter makes a hologram of himself in order to get out of menial household duties.

videos.title: The Stewaway
videos.overview: During a game of "hide and seek," Stewie takes refuge in Quagmire's suitcase, only to wind up in Paris. Meanwhile, Peter and Lois take a getaway to Vermont, where Lois is intent on breaking Bonnie's Instagram "like" record.

videos.title: Get Stewie
videos.overview: Stewie finds himself in public disgrace after a popstar unleashes her fan base on him for a benign comment. Meanwhile, Peter gets lap band surgery and enjoys the merriment of excess skin.

videos.title: Carny Knowledge
videos.overview: Peter and Chris finish last in a "Generation Gap" game at a carnival, forcing them to try to reconnect. Brian starts to date a carny, whom he can't break up with even after witnessing some of her crude habits.

videos.title: The Candidate
videos.overview: Stewie and Doug compete for the honor of class “snack captain”.

videos.title: Love Story Guy
videos.overview: The guys recount their first true love stories, leading to parodies of "Castaway," "Dirty Dancing" and various Meg Ryan rom-coms.

videos.title: Old West
videos.overview: The guys try to help Mayor Wild West reconnect with his estranged father, Old West.

videos.title: Single White Dad
videos.overview: Peter is mistaken for being a single parent, and relishes in the perks that come with it.

videos.title: White Meg Can't Jump
videos.overview: Meg joins the Adam West High basketball team, and her play is fueled by Peter's lambasting from the crowd. Meanwhile, Stewie goes down a rabbit hole of conspiracies, which ultimately ends with him developing multiple personalities.

videos.title: Adoptation
videos.overview: To restore his public image, Carter adopts a young girl from an orphanage, drawing jealousy from Lois.

videos.title: The Bird Reich
videos.overview: To take advantage of a work policy granting leave in the event of a pet's death, Peter adopts the oldest bird he can find... and realizes it used to belong to Hitler. Meanwhile, after giving Stewie a signed copy of his book, Brian finds it in a free library, causing Brian to give up writing.

videos.title: A Bottle Episode
videos.overview: Lois is blocked from a vacation rental app and accused of stealing after the family's trip to Nantucket. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian buy saltwater taffy in bulk, and try their hands at door-to-door sales in the community.

videos.title: Vat Man & Rob 'Em
videos.overview: When Peter gets a job as the new night watchman, he and the guys turn Pawtucket Brewery into an after-hours bar. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian's plan to collect "lost dog" return money backfires when Brian is used for a dangerous TikTok stunt.

videos.title: From Russia With Love
videos.overview: After Brian's Instagram is hacked, Meg takes Stewie and Brian to Russia, only to realize she'd rather stay there. Meanwhile, Lois reverts to her tormented teenage self when Quagmire starts dating her high school bully.

videos.title: Adult Education
videos.overview: Meg gets married in Russia but returns home after discovering she was used for a green card marriage. Meanwhile, Chris, in need of an extracurricular activity, joins Principal Shepherd in shooting pornos at the high school.

videos.title: Fertilized Megg
videos.overview: Meg agrees to be Bruce and Jeffery's surrogate causing a pregnant Meg to annoy her family. But, when the couple fails to pick up the baby, the Griffins must take care of their new family.

videos.title: Supermarket Pete
videos.overview: With the brewery under construction, Lois implores Peter to take a new job, but grows irate when he begins work at the grocery store. Meanwhile, armed with his police stories, Joe and Brian team up to write their own true crime novel.

videos.title: A Stache from the Past
videos.overview: When Peter loses the Griffins' home in a reverse mortgage, he and Mayor West travel to confront the man advertising the scheme, Tom Selleck. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian open a booth at the flea market, leading to a rivalry with Bruce.

videos.title: Old World Harm
videos.overview: Peter and Lois vacation in Florida, only to discover they've rented a condo in a retirement community. Back at home, Brian helps Stewie take his first shower.

videos.title: Baby, It's Cold Inside
videos.overview: Peter is emasculated when, on their anniversary, he abandons Lois amidst a shark attack. Meanwhile, Stewie finds a mini fridge and lives the dorm lifestyle.

videos.title: Boston Stewie
videos.overview: Stewie tries to civilize his half-brother, Boston Stewie, so that he may be adopted. Meanwhile, Meg and Chris start a venture in which people online pay Chris to sit on and smash cupcakes.

videos.title: Snap(ple) Decision
videos.overview: Winner of a Snapple contest, Lois uses her winnings to take Meg on a tropical vacation. Flaunting their wealth, the two are kidnapped. Meanwhile, Stewie and Brian undergo "friendship therapy."

videos.title: Baking Sad
videos.overview: Meg discovers her tears produce delicious cookies, and her, along with her siblings, enjoy a profit until the success makes her too happy to cry. Meanwhile, Peter and the guys launch a "male talk show."

videos.title: The Return of the King (of Queens)
videos.overview: Lois decides to sell the family's television to help pay for Christmas presents, but when Kevin James gets upset over losing Peter as a viewer, he apparates into the Griffin house.

videos.title: Cabin Pressure
videos.overview: When the Griffins win a trip to Maine at Peter's company picnic, they decide to invite their friends on the vacation. Tensions run high and things soon spiral out of control when the cabin burns down.

videos.title: Teacher's Heavy Pet
videos.overview: Lois joins Chris's school as a substitute teacher, launching him into the cool kids club... but only time will tell how long he remains a member.

videos.title: Take This Job and Love It
videos.overview: Peter and his friends wonder aloud about what their dream jobs would be.

videos.title: Lifeguard Meg
videos.overview: Stewie and Brian become overwhelmed after winning a coffee shop. Peter and his friends annoy Meg at her new lifeguard job when they don't follow the pool rules.

videos.title: Fat Actor
videos.overview: Peter tries to protest Hollywood after learning that Brad Pitt was cast in a biopic about a politician. After Pitt injures himself on set, Peter must act out the role himself.

videos.title: Faith No More
videos.overview: Brian becomes romantically interested in someone and it inspires him to use Stewie's time machine. Strange consequences result from their journey.

videos.title: Fat Gun
videos.overview: This "Top Gun" parody chronicles Peter/Maverick getting together with Lois/Charlie, the tragic death of Joe/Goose, and Peter/Maverick's blooming relationship with Chris/Rooster.

videos.title: Live, Laugh, Love
videos.overview: When Peter realizes Joe has never found him funny, he is determined to make Joe laugh; Lois chaperones Chris and Meg's school trip, where she strives to reunite the principal with his long-lost love.

videos.title: Drunk with Power
videos.overview: Peter swaps lives with Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh and is forced to make a ruling on the constitutionality of gay marriage, meanwhile, Brett tries to become friends with Quagmire, Cleveland and Joe.

videos.title: Lois C.K.
videos.overview: Lois becomes a stand-up comic, using real life stories about Peter as content; Peter tries his best to straighten his life out to avoid being ridiculed by Lois's act.

videos.title: The Chicken or the Meg
videos.overview: Meg starts dating a chicken she meets on a reality dating show.

videos.title: Dog Is My Co-Pilot
videos.overview: After successfully landing a plane, Brian and Quagmire go on a press tour. Meanwhile Chris and Stewie open a boutique pizza place.

videos.title: Pitch Imperfect
videos.overview: Peter must gain his family's respect back after he makes a humiliating throw. Brian and Stewie become chiropractors.

videos.title: Hard Times at Adam West High
videos.overview: Chris uses Stewie's time machine to stop himself from having an erection during a book report. Peter becomes jealous when he sits out of a lottery pool and the guys win.

videos.title: The Elle Word
videos.overview: When Quagmire starts dating a mystery woman, Peter, Joe and Cleveland go on a stakeout and discover her to be the librarian.

videos.title: A Real Who's Hulu
videos.overview: The Griffins spoof "Only Murders in the Building," "The Dropout," and "The Bear."

videos.title: China Doll
videos.overview: When Stewie sees a tag on Rupert reading "Made in China," he heads off to China to meet Rupert's family.

videos.title: One Foot in Front of the Mother
videos.overview: Due to a police complaint about his excessive barking, Brian has to wear a shock collar; looking to join an after-school team, Chris discovers a talent for speed walking.

videos.title: The Fat Lotus
videos.overview: In this Griffin-family twist on the popular HBO series, Peter suspects Lois of betraying his trust with Quagmire at a swanky vacation, while Stewie worries that his wealthy new friends plan to sacrifice him in a volcano.

videos.title: Cool Hand Lois
videos.overview: Lois embarks on a journey of self-discovery.

videos.title: Martian Meg
videos.overview: Fed up with feeling like she doesn't belong, Meg enlists in a training program for a mission to Mars.

videos.title: Row v. Wade
videos.overview: Brian wins a boat on "The Price is Right" and decides to sail to Texas to help women seeking legal abortions.

videos.title: Karenheit 451
videos.overview: Lois becomes the leader of a group of mothers who want to ban books from schools.

videos.title: Twain's World
videos.overview: In an effort to improve his writing, Brian convinces Stewie to go back in time and bring Mark Twain to the present day, but the plan goes awry when Twain overindulges in pornography.

videos.title: The Edible Arrangement [450th episode]
videos.overview: Lois and Stewie finally understand each other - thanks to Brian's edibles - and try to understand their complicated relationship.

videos.title: Pumpkin Spice Girls
videos.overview: Meg discovers the seasonal delight that is the pumpkin spice latte, but when the limited time offering lapses, she and Lois concoct an elaborate heist to steal the formula.

videos.title: Man-Fest Destiny
videos.overview: Peter and the guys become shipwrecked at Fire Island; Chris and Brian perform a lobotomy on a social-media-crazed Stewie.

videos.title: Bringing Up Brady
videos.overview: Meg pursues an unlikely friendship with an NFL great; Stewie and Brian host a dinner party at a home furnishing store.

videos.title: Dear Francis
videos.overview: Peter calls out the name "Francis" while making love with Lois, but she believes he meant his deceased father, leading to a round of therapy. Things worsen when Lois discovers "Frances" is the name of the Clam's new, pretty waitress.

videos.title: Viewer DMs
videos.overview: In this follow up to the "Viewer Mail" episodes, the Griffin family retells The Lord of the Rings, explains how the Griffins' ancestors arrived in Quahog, and looks back at Quagmire's 1960s variety show.

videos.title: Scent of a Woman
videos.overview: Brian discovers his nose can detect diseases and smells that someone in the Griffin house has cancer.

videos.title: Play Time
videos.overview: In this three-act parody, the Griffins spoof the stage by putting up To Kill a Mockingbird, The Odd Couple and Hamlet.

videos.title: Phony Montana
videos.overview: After going on a date with a Cuban-American woman named Carmen, Brian inexplicably develops a Cuban accent- which he worries will hurt his chances with her.

videos.title: A Few More Ways to Die in the West
videos.overview: In this Griffin family spoof of the Old West, Peter, known as Quiet Burp, and his gang of outlaws agrees to escort a wealthy businessman on a train journey.

videos.title: Tall Stewie
videos.overview: When Stewie puts on a pair of boots that make him slightly taller, his newfound confidence changes the power dynamic in the Griffin family.

videos.title: Lower G.I. Joe
videos.overview: A colonoscopy reveals Peter has a rare collectible toy action figure lodged in his intestine, but the reward for selling it causes a rift between him and the guys.

videos.title: Friend's Best Man
videos.overview: Stewie becomes engaged to Rupert, but Brian is upset when he is not chosen as the best man.

videos.title: Let the Goodtimes Walk
videos.overview: A powerful sleeping aid medication gives Joe the ability to walk while he is asleep, but Joe grows concerned when it becomes clear that the guys prefer his sleepwalking self.

videos.title: High School History
videos.overview: In this three-act parody of prominent historical eras, the Griffins take a humorous look at The French Revolution, the American Civil War, and World War II.
